## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates your breadth of AWS ML services integration, covering data residency with PrivateLink, real-time latency requirements, multi-model registry capabilities, per-tenant isolation, canary deployments, drift monitoring, and cost estimation.

## Key Concepts
- **PrivateLink and VPC data residency**: Ensure all data remains within the private VPC, accessible only through PrivateLink endpoints without exposing traffic to the public internet
- **SageMaker multi-model endpoints and Model Registry**: Host multiple models on a single endpoint for cost efficiency, with centralized model versioning and lifecycle management
- **Canary deployments and traffic shifting**: Gradually shift traffic to new model versions using SageMaker shadow variants or weighted routing
- **Drift monitoring with SageMaker Clarify**: Detect data and model quality drift to trigger retraining or rollback
- **Per-tenant routing and data isolation**: Use tenant context headers to route requests to appropriate model versions while maintaining strict logical separation
- **Cost budgeting and autoscaling**: Balance performance requirements with cost efficiency through right-sized instance counts and predictive autoscaling

## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design secure multi-tenant inference in a VPC with PrivateLink and privacy controls. It probes practical choices around model training, autoscaling, tenancy isolation, PII redaction, monitoring, and cost estimation.

## Key Concepts

- Multi-tenant isolation
- PrivateLink and VPC endpoints
- Inference autoscaling
- PII redaction strategies
- Post-processing with Lambda
- CloudWatch monitoring and cost awareness

## Code Example

```javascript
function redactPII(text) {
  return text
    .replace(/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/g, "[REDACTED_EMAIL]")
    .replace(/\b\d{3}[-.]?\d{3}[-.]?\d{4}\b/g, "[REDACTED_PHONE]");
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you test PII redaction coverage across real user data?
- What changes if a tenant spikes traffic unexpectedly for several hours?

## Why This Question Is Asked

This question assesses practical SageMaker skills with emphasis on private data handling, VPC boundaries, and multi-tenant routing. It also covers canary rollouts, drift detection, privacy validation, and cost estimation—essential competencies for production ML systems.

## Key Concepts

- **SageMaker Training & Endpoints:** Model lifecycle management, from training to deployment
- **PrivateLink & VPC Boundaries:** Ensuring data residency and security within customer VPCs
- **Model Registry & Canary Releases:** Safe deployment strategies with gradual traffic shifting
- **Multi-Tenant Architecture:** Per-tenant isolation, routing, and encryption at rest and in transit
- **Operational Excellence:** Drift detection, A/B testing, and cost optimization
